summary: Correctness pass: the diff does what the spec says. I traced the new streaming opening loop in src/lib/chat/orchestrate.ts (sentence-by-sentence rescreen with drops, final-call and catch-block paths), the delimiter list in src/lib/voice.ts (regex construction, Pi/Pf categories plus named marks, apostrophe word-start exception, nesting), and the reworked citation resolution in verifyQuotedSpan (window and sentence-boundary offsets computed over the same 240-char suffix; same-sentence-versus-nearest-name fallback matches the documented rule). Quotation-in-verbatim-in-cited-document passes, misattribution and fabrication are refused, stray delimiters are refused rather than streamed, impersonating openings never reach the reader, and clean answers still arrive unaltered and chunking-invariant. The new tests pin exactly the previously exploited bypasses. I found no drift from AC1–AC13 and no correctness defect introduced by this branch versus d42bbb0.
